Our Promise, Your Agreement

Welcome to Fragal Perfumes — fragalperfumes.pk is our house, run by us in Pakistan. When you browse our website or place an order, you agree to these Terms of Service, together with our Privacy Policy, Shipping Policy and Return & Refund Policy, which are part of these terms. If anything here is unclear, or you need help with an order, reach us on WhatsApp at +92 308 4456947 or email info@fragalperfumes.pk — a real person replies.

Shopping With Us

Every order you place is a promise we take seriously — and it is subject to availability and our confirmation. We may call or message you on WhatsApp, SMS or telephone to confirm your order before it leaves us; if we cannot reach you to confirm, your order may not be shipped. Please give your correct name, address and phone number — a wrong number or address can delay or cancel your delivery, and we cannot take responsibility for that.

Prices & Paying

All our prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and include taxes unless we say otherwise. Prices can change at any time, but the price you pay is the one shown when you placed your order. We accept cash on delivery — our courier partner collects the full order amount from you when your parcel arrives, on our behalf.

Getting Your Order

How fast your order reaches you, what delivery costs, and what happens along the way is explained in our Shipping Policy — it is part of these terms, so please read it. In short: we dispatch carefully, the courier delivers, and tracking updates keep you informed.

Changed Your Mind?

If the fragrance is not for you, our Return & Refund Policy and Exchange Policy have you covered — they are part of these terms. The essentials: 15 days, the bottle with 90%+ remaining in its original packaging, and a quick message to us on WhatsApp to begin.

What You See Is What We Mean

We photograph and describe our products honestly. Still, product images are illustrative — slight variations in packaging can occur — and fragrance is personal: how ZARAN smells on one person may differ slightly on another. That is the nature of perfume, not a flaw.

Respecting Our Craft

Everything that makes Fragal ours — the Fragal Perfumes name and logo, the ZARAN name, our bottle designs, photographs, videos, descriptions and every word on this website — belongs to us or is used under licence. Please do not use our name, logo or content in any business name, domain, social media account, advertisement or product listing, and do not copy or scrape our images or text, without our written permission. We protect our craft.

Using Fragal Safely

ZARAN is made to be sprayed on clothes — collar, chest or sleeves — not directly on skin. Fragrances contain ingredients that may not suit everyone, so if you have sensitive skin, be cautious. Keep the bottle away from children and away from heat and open flame.

House Rules

This website is for genuine shopping. Please do not: place orders with false names, addresses or phone numbers; try to defraud us or game the cash-on-delivery system; upload viruses or attempt to break the website’s security; copy, scrape or automate collection of our content; or use the website for anything unlawful. If these rules are broken, we may cancel orders and restrict access to the website.

The Fine Print

We work hard to keep everything on this website accurate, but we cannot promise it is free of errors, and to the fullest extent the law allows, we are not liable for such errors. We are not responsible for delays caused by courier companies, for products used against our guidance, or for losses caused by incorrect information you gave us. Occasionally we may have to decline an order — usually because the product is out of stock, we cannot deliver to your area, we could not confirm the order with you, or something beyond our control intervened.

If Things Change

We may update these Terms of Service as our house grows. The latest version will always be on this page with its date, and by continuing to shop with us after a change, you accept the updated terms.

The Law That Guides Us

These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
